reading.action: Backtrack floors 1-2 (both cleared) to forage at least an armful of burnable fuel and bring it to the brazier-stand.
reading.result: SOLID SUCCESS (margin 12). Foraged a real armful of burnables. Floor 1 (threshold, driest ground) = the good fuel: dry splintered wood + brittle husk-fiber + dry kindling from the Ashling-fight leavings. Floor 2 (cistern, wet) = slimmer/damp pickings: a few lengths of high-edge driftwood, damp-skinned but sound-cored (will burn once a coal bed is going). Net: serviceable sustained-fire fuel, NOT premium (some damp). Brought to the brazier-stand as directed -> item 'Armful of fuel' staged at the cache. COST: Stamina 45 -> 42 (-3, the down-and-back haul). No skill/affinity/essence work this turn. Backtrack through cleared floors uneventful (floors as left). NO Tower reset.
